jobs.occupation: EWIS/Harness/Wiring Systems Engineer (all genders) (Ingenieur/in - Erneuerbare Energien)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLEAs EWIS/Harness/Wiring Systems Engineer, you own the Electrical Wiring Interconnection System of our eVTOL aircraft at system level: its requirements, its architecture, and the compliance evidence that makes it certifiable. You define how power, signal and data move safely through the aircraft, covering separation, protection, grounding and bonding, EMC and maintainability, and you keep that definition traceable and configuration-controlled from the first requirement through to certification. You will work directly with our safety and certification team, with suppliers and with regulatory partners, in a genuinely shaping role on a programme that is building a real aircraft.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Own the EWIS system requirements, assumptions and allocated constraints — complete, consistent, traceable and configuration-controlled across aircraft, subsystem and certification baselines
• Define the EWIS architecture and interfaces for safe power, signal and data distribution, covering separation, protection, grounding/bonding, EMC, maintainability and integration constraints
• Translate certification objectives into applicable requirements, means of compliance, and the evidence needed to close them
• Assess change requests, deviations and non-conformances for their safety, compliance, configuration and verification impact
• Own the EWIS verification and validation strategy — reviews, analyses, inspections, tests and compliance demonstrations — through to requirements closure
• Keep the EWIS baseline aligned with design, safety and certification, configuration management, and our suppliers as the aircraft matures
• Continuously challenge and improve our technical concepts, tools, and methods

WHAT YOU BRING
• At least 3 years of systems engineering experience with aircraft, aerospace, or comparable safety-critical electrical and wiring systems
• Have worked with requirements and configuration tools such as DOORS, Polarion, Jama, Teamcenter, 3DEXPERIENCE, Siemens Capital or Zuken E3
• The ability to define, manage and verify requirements, interfaces, traceability and technical change impact across a full product lifecycle
• Working knowledge of certification, compliance and safety processes relevant to aircraft electrical or EWIS topics
• A practical understanding of configuration management, baselines, change control and released technical data
• Professional English, strong enough to write requirements and compliance evidence and to carry cross-functional technical decisions
• A degree in electrical/electronic engineering or a related field — or equivalent knowledge gained on the job

Moreover, it would be helpful if you also
• Have experience with CS/FAR 25.1700, DO-160, ARP4754A/B, ARP4761, SAE AS50881 or comparable standards
• Know the manufacturing, installation and test constraints that harness design has to live with
• Have prepared certification plans, compliance checklists, conformity evidence or verification matrices

Working closely with specialists from propulsion, high-voltage electrical systems, avionics, structures, thermal management, testing, and flight-test teams, you contribute to the system-level definition and maturation of the low-voltage system. From requirements to verification, you drive the development of a safety-critical system at the heart of the aircraft.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Taking responsibility for a complete, consistent, and traceable requirements baseline aligned with aircraft, certification, safety, and program needs
• Ensuring that system architecture, interfaces, operating modes, and constraints are defined, baselined, and kept consistent with neighboring systems
• Communicating system-level assumptions, risks, and trade-offs

• Aligning suppliers, discipline teams, and integration partners in the sense that they work against the same technical baseline, interfaces, and acceptance criteria

• Professional working English for technical documentation and stakeholder communication
• Experience in aviation or a comparably regulated industry, such as Space, Automotive, or Defense Industry

• High level of self-management with the ability to work in a team, as well as an autonomous, target-oriented, and driven work style with analytic problem-solving skills

Moreover, it would be helpful if you also have
• Familiarity with ARP4754A/B, ARP4761, DO-178C, DO-254, ISO 26262, or comparable standards

In this role, you will ensure the flight readiness of our unmanned aircraft through ground tests, flight tests and demonstration campaigns. You will take ownership of operational maintenance, assess the aircraft's technical status and provide the maintenance release for flight.Working directly with our pilots, flight test engineers and development teams, you will troubleshoot complex prototype systems, translate findings into practical improvements and help establish maintenance processes that are safe, efficient and easy to apply. Your hands-on experience will also contribute to the design of our products, helping us improve maintainability from an early stage and create solutions that simplify inspection, servicing and repair in day-to-day operations. • Ensure that our unmanned aircraft and related operational equipment are ready for operation.

• Assess the aircraft's maintenance and airworthiness status, release it for flight and ground it when safety-relevant findings remain unresolved
• Establish and continuously improve maintenance plans, records, instructions, checklists and manuals
• Document defects and maintenance-related occurrences clearly, track them to closure and provide practical feedback to engineering, manufacturing and airworthiness teams

• A disciplined working style and a strong safety mindset guide your decisions in a demanding aviation test environment
• Clear documentation comes naturally to you, whether you are recording maintenance work, describing findings or proposing process improvements
• You enjoy working hands-on at the aircraft as part of the flight team and are willing to travel frequently to national and international locations
• Fluent English enables you to work effectively in our international and interdisciplinary environment

Your missionJob Summary
As a Verification & Validation Engineer / Regulatory Compliance Medical Devices (m/w/d), you will work closely with all R&D departments and Regulatory Affairs. In this role, you will analyze, interpret, and review regulations and standards to ensure ongoing compliance of our medical devices, software solutions, and processes. You will support our products throughout their entire lifecycle, from initial concept and development to market launch. In addition, you will translate normative requirements into technical specifications and coordinate all compliance activities with external test laboratories and regulatory authorities.
Key Responsibilities:
a) Standards & Regulatory Compliance
• Identify relevant international standards and regulatory requirements for medical devices.
• Interpret and translate standards into actionable system and engineering requirements.
• Create and maintain standards matrices, applicability matrices, and compliance checklists.
• Ensure compliance with the IEC 60601 series as well as MDR and FDA requirements.
• Monitor updates to relevant standards and conduct delta analyses to assess their impact on products.
b) Verification and Validation
• Manage and execute conformity testing in the following areas:
o Electrical safety
o Electromagnetic compatibility (EMC)
o Functional safety
o Software Lifecycle Compliance
• Coordinate and communicate directly with external, accredited test laboratories.
• Create and evaluate test plans and test reports regarding potential compliance deviations.
• Independently resolve regulatory and technical issues during certification testing.
c) Product Development Support
• Collaborate closely with system architects and engineering teams during the concept, design, and verification phases.
• Ensure that all compliance activities are seamlessly integrated into the product development process.
• Review system requirements, architecture, interfaces, and design documentation.
Additional Responsibilities:
• Take ownership of change impact analyses to evaluate the regulatory and normative impact of product changes.
• Conduct training sessions and provide guidance to development teams regarding standards and compliance best practices.
• Actively contribute to regulatory strategy discussions for new products and global market clearances.

Your profilea) Education
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or a related technical discipline with a strong focus on product compliance.
b) Experience & Technical Skills
• Minimum of 5 years of proven professional experience in medical device development or compliance engineering.
• In-depth understanding of relevant IEC standards for medical electrical equipment (ME equipment):
o IEC 60601-1 (General requirements for basic safety)
o IEC 60601-1-2 (Electromagnetic compatibility / EMC)
o IEC 60601-1-6 (Usability)
o IEC 60601-2-xx (Product-specific particular standards)
• Hands-on experience with ALM tools (e.g., Codebeamer, Polarion, DOORS).
• Solid knowledge of EMC and electrical safety principles.
• Strong proficiency in systems engineering and requirements management.
• Extensive experience with technical documentation and design control processes.
• Professional fluency in English (written and verbal) for international collaboration with regulatory bodies and test laboratories (German language skills are a plus).
c) Personal Attributes
• Strong analytical capabilities and a solution-oriented mindset.
• Ability to precisely interpret complex standards and regulatory requirements.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to constructively and objectively challenge design decisions based on data.
• Team player who thrives in an interdisciplinary, collaborative environment.
• Self-motivated, structured, and detail-oriented work ethic.

Aufgaben
WHAT WE DO
Picture the car of the future. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie?

We believe the car of the future is already here—and it’s a connected vehicle that can be used as a payment device. Here at Mercedes pay, we enable seamless, secure, and trustworthy payments across the entire Mercedes-Benz ecosystem. We develop sleek new payment products & solutions to provide customers with an effortless, convenient user experience; not just via an app or web browser, but even in-car. The car as a payment device? We made it happen!

Mercedes-Benz is known for its legacy, but innovation and legacy are not mutually exclusive—quite the contrary. Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. To sum it up, we are the FinTech branch or knowledge hub for payments within Mercedes-Benz.
ABOUT MERCEDES PAY
Mercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. This is how Mercedes pay directly contributes to the mobility and digitalization strategy of Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Berlin, Stuttgart, and Farmington Hills (USA).

2023 has already been a big year—we launched full online vehicle payments in the UK and introduced native in-car payments in Germany, an industry-first feature by which users can pay directly by fingerprint inside their car. That’s the car of the future we’re talking about!

We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn.
